policy: Admit when an original statement by the dataset creators (card or README text, a licence file covering data distributed with it, or the release archive's licence) permits research training use. Hub tags and code-repository licences alone are not a basis. Permission to train is recorded separately from redistribution; nothing is redistributed. NC terms are not a reason to exclude. Media origin is recorded; per-image rights of scraped or web media are not independently verified.
retrieved: 2026-10-31/2026-11-01 from the step 5 CPU host; files under outputs/step05/terms/ (machine-local)
